pushPrompt.text: Turn on push notifications. You'll get session reminders, open slots and messages from your trainer.

sessionsPage.nie_moge_przyjsc_wysyla_informacje: “I can't come” sends a message to your trainer. The trainer cancels the session (according to the school's rules) and may offer the slot to others.

slotsSection.zgloszono_czekasz_na_decyzje_trenera: Request sent. You're waiting for the trainer's decision.
slotsSection.gdy_zwolni_sie_termin_dostaniesz: When a slot opens up, you'll get a notification. Whoever taps “I'll take it” first has priority, but the trainer chooses.
slotsSection.zapisz_sie_na_liste_chetnych_gdy_ktos: Join the waitlist: when someone cancels, you'll get a notification and can take the open slot.
